title: Fine-grained: named tuple definition with a function crashes
body:
This fine-grained incremental mode test case causes a crash:

```
[case testNamedTupleSpecialCase]
from typing import NamedTuple
import b
def f() -> None:
    b.x
    n = NamedTuple('n', [])
[file b.py]
x = 0
[file b.py.2]
x = ''
[out]
==
```
